headings.title: Expunging contributed information
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 7 requires expungement from the system when state law requires.

headings.title: Uniform data set
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 8 covers four minimum data categories (1)-(4).

headings.title: Providing investigative documents
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 9 requires administrators to provide requested investigative documents and information.

headings.title: Commission establishment, venue, and immunity
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 1 covers the joint public entity, venue, waiver for dispute resolution, and no waiver of sovereign immunity. Notes: effective 7-20-17; S.B. 608 veto override.

headings.title: Administrators, voting, and meetings
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 2 read with (1)-(6): one administrator per state, votes, annual meeting, public notice, ten closed-meeting grounds (a)-(j), certification and sealed minutes.

headings.title: Bylaws and rules content
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 3 covers majority-vote bylaws or rules with items (1)-(6), including closed-session votes and personnel policies.

headings.title: Publication of bylaws and rules
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 4 requires website publication.

headings.title: Financial records
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 5 requires records under the bylaws.

headings.title: Commission meetings and actions
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 6 requires actions consistent with the compact and bylaws.

headings.title: Commission powers
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 7 lists fifteen powers, including binding uniform rules, legal proceedings, personnel, property, budget, borrowing, and committees.

headings.title: Finances, assessments, and audits
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 8 covers expenses, annual assessments, no obligations without funds, and annual audit.

headings.title: Immunity, defense, and indemnification
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 9 covers immunity, defense and indemnity for commission personnel with misconduct exceptions.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and binding effect
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 1 covers criteria and binding date of rules and amendments.

headings.title: Adoption at commission meetings
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 2 requires adoption at regular or special meetings.

headings.title: Notice of proposed rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 3 requires filing at least sixty days before the meeting, on commission and state websites or publications.

headings.title: Contents of rulemaking notice
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 4 lists four notice items.

headings.title: Written comments on proposed rules
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 5 allows written submissions before adoption.

headings.title: Public hearing opportunity
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 6 requires opportunity for hearing before adoption.

headings.title: Hearing publication and conduct
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 7 covers publication, comment opportunity, recording, and grouped hearings.

headings.title: Proceeding when no one appears
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 8 says the commission "may" proceed if no one appears.

headings.title: Consideration of comments
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 9 requires consideration after the hearing date.

headings.title: Final action by majority of administrators
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 10 covers majority vote and effective date.

headings.title: Emergency rules
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 11 covers adoption without prior notice for three emergency grounds with retroactive procedures within ninety days.

headings.title: Correcting adopted rule errors
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 12 covers revisions, notice, thirty-day challenge for material change, and approval if challenged.

headings.title: State enforcement and service on the commission
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 1 covers state enforcement duty and commission service of process, standing, and voidness of judgments without service. Notes: effective 7-20-17 per § 335.420; S.B. 608 veto override.

headings.title: Default and termination of membership
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 2 read with (1)-(6): notice, remedial help, termination by majority vote after other means are exhausted, liabilities, costs, and appeal.

headings.title: Dispute resolution
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 3 covers commission resolution, mediation and binding rule, and arbitration panel with final majority decision.

headings.title: Commission enforcement actions
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 4 covers enforcement discretion, majority-vote legal action against defaulting states, relief and costs, and non-exclusive remedies.

headings.title: Effective date and prior compact withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 1 covers earlier of enactment by 26 states or December 31, 2018, and deemed withdrawal from prior compact within six months. Notes: effective 7-20-17 per § 335.420; S.B. 608 veto override.

headings.title: Recognition of prior compact privileges
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 2 continues recognition until the state withdraws from the prior compact.

headings.title: Withdrawal by repealing statute
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 3 covers repeal and six-month delay.

headings.title: Continuing reporting after withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 4 preserves reporting of earlier adverse actions and investigations.

headings.title: Agreements with non-party states
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 5 preserves arrangements made consistent with the compact.

headings.title: Amendment of compact
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 6 requires enactment by all party states.

headings.title: Non-party state representatives
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 7 invites nonvoting participation before adoption by all states.

headings.title: State labor laws not superseded
